name: workspace-downloads
description: Repeatable batch downloads of selected workspace files to your local machine, from remote or local VS Code workspaces.

workspaceDownloads.files.markdownDescription:
Workspace-relative files or glob patterns to download. Enter one item per nonempty line and use `/` as the path separator.

Examples:

- `file-1.txt` downloads that file
- `folder/file-1.txt` downloads that file from `folder`
- `file-1.txt` on one line and `file-2.txt` on the next downloads both files
- `*.txt` downloads all `.txt` files
- `file-1.txt` on one line and `*.md` on the next downloads that file and all Markdown files

workspaceDownloads.destination.markdownDescription: Optional local destination folder on this desktop client. When empty, each download asks for a folder and remembers the last choice. Do not commit a machine-specific destination to shared workspace settings.

enumDescriptions: Ask whether to replace or skip when destination conflicts are found.
Replace all destination conflicts without asking.
Skip all destination conflicts without asking.
workspaceDownloads.conflictPolicy.markdownDescription: Controls how existing destination files and output-path collisions are handled. Use the **Workspace Downloads: Configure Download Conflict Policy** command to open this setting directly.

task.description: Exact workspace-folder task label that triggers this download after a successful exit.

files.description: Workspace-relative files or glob patterns, one per line.

destination.description: Local destination folder on this desktop client.

conflictPolicy.description: How to handle existing destination files and output-path collisions.

workspaceDownloads.taskDownloads.markdownDescription: Downloads to run after named workspace-folder tasks exit successfully. Each entry requires an exact task label, newline-separated workspace-relative files or glob patterns, a local destination, and a conflict policy.
